programs.title: The Secret History of World War II
programs.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.

programs.title: Disasters Engineered
programs.desc: A series devoted to the greatest engineering disasters in the history of mankind.Chernobyl, Titanic and Hinderburg - these are examples of bold technological experiments that ended tragically.
